newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Moody's assigns A1/P1 to Korean Housing & Com Bank.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns A1/P1 to Korean Housing & Com Bank.

text.p: Moody's said on Wednesday it has assigned A1/Prime-1 ratings to deposits of Korea's Housing & Commerical Bank (H&CB).
Moody's also said it rated the bank's long-term debt at A1 and financial strength at C+.

The ratings reflect the Housing & Commercial Bank's sound financial condition, including its good asset quality, substantial capital base following the share offering earlier this year and its strong business franchise, it said.

It also reflects the bank's relatively low profitability, as well as the likelihood that competition in residential mortgage lending would intensify and that the development of a securitised mortgage market will substantially change the structure of the bank's core business, the rating agency said.

The deposit and debt ratings also take into account the close relationship between the bank and the government of Korea, and the role of the bank in implementing important government policies, it said.
This is the first time rating for the bank, it added. -- Hong Kong newsroom (852) 2843 6369
